accept_on_device_threshold.description: Canonical threshold. Key read in apps/web/src/firebase.ts (getNumber). Value matches packages/core/src/routing.ts DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS.acceptOnDevice. At or above this grounded confidence, accept the on-device field; otherwise send it to the cloud. Not a clinically validated operating point.

human_review_threshold.description: Canonical threshold. Key read in apps/web/src/firebase.ts (getNumber). Value matches packages/core/src/routing.ts DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS.humanReview. After a cloud check, confidence below this (or a device/cloud disagreement) goes to human confirm.

cloud_model_name.description: Not wired in the web app yet. The app currently pins CLOUD_MODEL = 'gemini-3.5-flash-lite' in apps/web/src/firebase.ts (and packages/core/src/cost.ts). Avenger still needs to read this key from Remote Config. Keep a stable model name during judging.
